description: Team-drafted entries for topics first-year students ask about often in the New Student Q&A Corner but that no official FAQ covers. Drafted only from staff replies to the development half of the Q&A Corner (even question ids), with names and personal details removed. Not yet approved: each needs Student Success staff sign-off before go-live.

faqs.question: How do I find InPlace and book my placement or Sim Block?
alternatives: where is InPlace in the portal
I can't find the placement app
how do I book my simulation block
nominate dates for sim block
when will my placement start and who do I contact
placement to-do list not showing in InPlace
nursing placement booking
faqs.answer:
Placements and Simulation Blocks (Sim Blocks) are managed in **InPlace**. Log in to the **CDU Portal**, open **My Apps** and choose **Placements (InPlace)**.

- InPlace updates within about **24 hours** of you enrolling in the placement or Sim Block unit. You'll then see a notification to book your spot.
- Nursing students can also find Sim Block details in the **School of Nursing** unit in Learnline.
- For anything else about your placement, contact the **placements team** for your course.

If Placements isn't in your My Apps list, contact **Student Central** on **1800 061 963**.

faqs.question: Do I have to attend classes live if I study online?
alternatives: are lectures recorded so I can watch later
I work full time and can't attend live tutorials
is attendance compulsory for external students
can I watch the lecture the next morning
my classes clash with work
how does attendance work online
faqs.answer:
Most lectures and tutorials are **recorded**, so you can watch them later in **Learnline**. Open your unit and look under **Collaborate**.

For external (online) students, live attendance usually isn't compulsory. Some units do have required live sessions, though, so check your unit's Learnline site when it opens in O-Week.

If you can't make a class, let your **lecturer or unit coordinator** know.

faqs.question: Are my class times in Darwin time or my local time?
alternatives: is my timetable in NT time
what time zone is the timetable in
I live interstate, which time are my classes
timetable Brisbane time or Darwin time
faqs.answer:
Timetables are published in **Darwin (NT) time**, but the Portal timetable and Learnline convert class times to **your computer's time zone**.

So if your computer is set to Queensland time, your timetable shows Queensland time. If you're unsure, check with your lecturer.

faqs.question: Why is my timetable empty or still changing?
alternatives: my classes aren't showing on my timetable yet
when will my class timetable be confirmed
classes on my timetable keep changing
I can't see anything on my timetable
faqs.answer:
Not all classes are confirmed early on. Timetables come out progressively and are all out **before Week 1**, and some units are still being finalised until then. Check your timetable about **once a week** for updates.

If it's still not appearing after you've followed the **New to CDU checklist**, and it's urgent, contact the **Timetable team**.

faqs.question: Why can't I see my units or their content in Learnline yet?
alternatives: when will my units open on Learnline
I enrolled but can't access my units
my unit modules are empty after week 2
unit content is locked
registered for units but no access
faqs.answer:
Units usually open in Learnline around **O-Week**, and lecturers often release content **week by week**, so later weeks can look empty for now.

For questions about a unit's content, contact your **unit coordinator**. If you're enrolled but a unit doesn't appear at all, contact **Student Central** on **1800 061 963** or **student.central@cdu.edu.au**.

faqs.question: Am I studying full-time or part-time, and how many units should I take?
alternatives: how do I know if I'm full time or part time
how many units is full time
I'm part time, do I just pick two units from my study plan
study load per semester
do I enrol for the whole year or just the semester
faqs.answer:
Usually **2 units or fewer** in a semester is **part-time**. A full-time load is more than that, typically **4 units** per semester.

To check your study load, log in to the **CDU Portal**, then go to **My Apps > MyStudentInfo > Enrolment**. You only need to enrol for the **upcoming semester**, not the whole year.

Study plans work for part-time study too. If you're not sure which units to pick, contact **Student Central** on **1800 061 963**.

faqs.question: Can I come to orientation on campus if I study online?
alternatives: online students attend orientation in person
do new students get a welcome pack
where do I get my welcome pack
can external students go to O-Week
can I attend lectures on campus as an online student
faqs.answer:
Yes. **All students are welcome** at in-person orientation, events and lectures, including online students.

Welcome packs are handed out at **in-person orientation**, so come along to collect yours.

faqs.question: How do I get a student card if I study online?
alternatives: apply for a student card in the portal
student card for external students
I live overseas, how do I get my student card
student card eForm
faqs.answer:
You can apply online. Log in to the **CDU Portal**, open **eForms** and choose **Student Card** (near the bottom).

If you live overseas, email **Student Central** at **student.central@cdu.edu.au** to ask for a digital copy, as they may not be able to post a card overseas.
